title: Compose the ordered setup command over the existing primitives
statement: Implement `bin/setup.mjs` running the ordered phases: path resolution, Node validation, the setup lock, the locked dependency install, the dynamic imports, the transaction plan, initialization, the project ID and state protection, the journal, trust, package registration, consent, model binding, credential contract, research choice, preflight, canary and read-back — with every installed dependency imported dynamically after the install step, and no second initializer.
notes:
⚠️ R9 IS SETUP'S (recorded 2026-09-13). The skill-override entry `../planning-content/skills-overrides` is fixed relative to `.pi`, while the content root can be selected elsewhere, for example through `PLANNING_CONTENT_DIR`. Setup owns making the entry it writes agree with the selected content root's `skills-overrides/`. TSK-0047 proves the entry only in the default layout, where the content root is `<project>/planning-content`.

⚠️ STAGE-DOCUMENT MIGRATION IS SETUP'S (recorded 2026-09-18, TSK-0049). `kiln_write_stage_document` writes into a `## Intake` section with two anchored regions, and refuses a document that does not have them rather than upgrading one during a write: a write is not the moment to restructure a document somebody may have edited. Projects initialized before that section existed therefore cannot record an answer until their stage documents carry it. Setup owns adding it, the same way it owns making the skill-override entry agree with the selected content root. Kiln's own Stage 1 document was migrated by hand as a one-off and is not the general answer.

⚠️ THE ORDER IS D26 (2026-09-22): paths, Node, lock, install, dynamic imports, plan, initializer, project ID and state protection, journal, then the remaining phases. The dependency install comes before the transaction plan because the plan validates existing Kiln records, and that validation needs Ajv, which the install is what provides. Everything up to and including the install is therefore built-ins only (ACC-0083), and the install is a bootstrap mutation confined to the .planning checkout: it changes no consumer project state and does not rewrite the lockfile.
